intro: Dealing with a wasp or hornet nest in Clifton, Staten Island? The Best Pest Control NYC provides targeted nest treatment and removal throughout this historic neighborhood. localContext: Clifton's tree-lined streets, proximity to Clove Lakes Park, and abundance of older homes with eaves and attics create ideal nesting spots for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets during warmer months. From the historic neighborhoods near Vanderbilt Avenue to properties along the Clove Lakes corridor, our team provides rapid response throughout the entire Clifton community.
